name: Val Hoyle

positions.statement: On her House website's housing page, Hoyle says she supports expanding affordable and workforce housing.
positions.excerpt: I support expanding affordable and workforce housing.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: In a January 2024 joint press release on HUD homelessness funding for Oregon, Hoyle is quoted calling the $60 million in federal funds an important lifeline.
positions.excerpt: This $60 million in federal funds offers an important lifeline

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: On her House website's education page, Hoyle says that as a first-generation college student she understands the value of making higher education affordable.
positions.excerpt: As a first-generation college student, I understand the value of investing in higher education and ensuring it is affordable.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: On her House website's environment page, Hoyle says she strongly supports managing natural resources to protect the environment and special places.
positions.excerpt: I strongly support managing our natural resources to protect our environment and special places

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: On her House website's environment page, Hoyle's office describes her Southwestern Oregon Watershed and Salmon Protection Act as protecting local rivers, clean drinking water and salmon habitat.
positions.excerpt: would permanently protect Southwestern Oregon rivers, clean drinking water, wild salmon habitats

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: On her House website's transportation page, Hoyle says she is proud to fight for the Fourth District's transportation and infrastructure needs.
positions.excerpt: I’m proud to fight for the Fourth Congressional District’s transportation and infrastructure needs in Congress.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: On her House website's infrastructure page, Hoyle says she is committed to ensuring rural and coastal communities are not left behind.
positions.excerpt: I am committed to ensuring that our rural and coastal communities are not left behind.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: On her House website's veterans page, Hoyle says the country made a promise to veterans and she intends to see it through.
positions.excerpt: Our country made a promise to our veterans, and I have every intention of seeing it through.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: In a September 2025 press release, Hoyle's office says she joined Oregon lawmakers in a letter to USDA opposing plans that the release says would weaken wildfire response.
positions.excerpt: Oregon lawmakers warn USDA plan would weaken wildfire response, disrupt critical research, and jeopardize 246 local jobs.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: In a March 2025 press release, Hoyle says her district feeds the world and that she wants to highlight women farmers, naming a farmer as her State of the Union guest.
positions.excerpt: My district feeds the world, and I am proud to bring attention to her work to highlight women farmers.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: OPB reported in September 2026 that, in an interview with KLCC, Hoyle said she wants federal legislation on AI quickly.
positions.excerpt: What I want is federal legislation and federal legislation quickly.

positions.statement: In a January 2025 press release, Hoyle says two semiconductor manufacturers should adopt neutrality agreements that let workers organize without fear of retribution.
positions.excerpt: Both companies should adopt neutrality agreements that allow workers to organize without the fear of retribution.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: In an April 2026 statement on Iran, Hoyle says she is again calling on Congress to vote on the War Powers Resolution.
positions.excerpt: I am once again calling on Congress to vote on the War Powers Resolution and put a stop to this—now.

source.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Val Hoyle (hoyle.house.gov)

positions.statement: KOIN reported in February 2026 that Hoyle's Vote at Home Act aims to bring Oregon's voting model nationwide.
positions.excerpt: The bill aims to bring Oregon's voting model nationwide.
